capacity_identification_hierarchy.shared_capacity_not_identified_use_sensi: retains count scale without claiming a frontier

capacity_profile_rule.adequate_regime_samples: low=stress p90, central=pooled p90, high=non-stress p95

composition_groups.mixed_collateral: positive closures and largest collateral closure share below 0.90
composition_groups.single_collateral_dominant: positive closures and largest collateral closure share at or above 0.90

capacity_profile_rule.composition_widening: if mixed and single-collateral-dominant p90s differ by at least two and 25 per cent with at least ten hours each, lower low to the smaller composition p90 and raise high to the largest robustness p95
capacity_profile_rule.inadequate_regime_samples: low=pooled p75, central=pooled p90, high=pooled p95

level1_stability_rules.bootstrap_narrowness: primary day-block p90 interval width no greater than both two opportunities and 25 per cent of the estimate
level1_stability_rules.stable_upper_clustering: at least three repetitions of a common upper-quartile completed count
level1_stability_rules.threshold_robustness: p90 range below both two opportunities and 25 per cent

execution_stress_definition.crypto_downside: minimum ETH/WBTC 24-hour log return <= calibration q05
execution_stress_definition.high_gas: median effective gas price >= calibration q90
execution_stress_definition.high_volatility: maximum ETH/WBTC realised hourly-return volatility over 24 hours >= calibration q90
execution_stress_definition.stress_rule: at least two of the three conditions

high_demand_definition.prohibition: positive observed closures are not a substitute denominator

population_scaling_hierarchy.level_b: population-scaled only when source and target vault denominators are both valid
population_scaling_hierarchy.level_c: raw primary count plus later 250/500/1000-vault sensitivities

profit_equation.historical_direct_proxy: direct_profit = Take.owe_dai * effective liquidation penalty - clean top-level transaction gas cost USD
profit_equation.negative_evidence_rule: a failed decoded call is not a rejected economic opportunity; Level 1 requires observable full economics for a rejected or genuinely negative decision
profit_equation.simulator: debt_repaid = vault.debt_dai * max_close_factor; gross_reward = debt_repaid * liquidation_penalty; risk_cost = debt_repaid * risk_cost_rate; expected_profit = gross_reward - gas_cost - risk_cost; execute iff expected_profit > 0

profit_hurdle_hierarchy.level3: zero central and low, with one separately sourced conservative scenario only

successful_only_level2.interpretation: non-negative lower-bound sensitivities, not rejection threshold estimates

runtime_semantic_audit.capacity_scope: global shared count after cross-collateral ranking
runtime_semantic_audit.equation: expected_profit = debt_repaid * liquidation_penalty - gas_cost - debt_repaid * risk_cost_rate

scope.capacity_scope: one system-wide shared hourly count cap
scope.capacity_unit: protocol-level liquidation opportunities per one-hour simulation step
